Lemma
[backward parabolic curvature control near blow-up points] Source: cao-zhu 1. Lemma 7.1.2\group Canonical Neighborhood Structures

For each $(\bar{x},\bar{t})$ with $t_k-\frac{1}{2}H_kQ_k^{-1}\leq \bar{t}\leq t_k$, we have $R_k(x,t)\leq 4\bar{Q}_k$ whenever $\bar{t}-c\bar{Q}_k^{-1}\leq t\leq \bar{t}$ and $d^2_{\bar{t}}(x,\bar{x})\leq c\bar{Q}_k^{-1}$, where $\bar{Q}_k=Q_k+R_k(\bar{x},\bar{t})$ and $c>0$ is a small universal constant.
